desc: How the bond meter fills (it gates R, the Merge). All values are fractions of a full meter. Your Boki's hits mark the foe for mark_s seconds, and your own hits on a marked foe fill the meter marked_factor times faster. (Every point of damage you or your Boki deal also adds 1/320, see Match.on_damage.)
ult_note: ult: what landing a hero ultimate on X adds to the meter (HeroUlt.pay_bond), per hero. Only enemy hunters count, and only when the ult lands: never on the cast. ashwick: each distinct hunter the lava touches adds each, up to cap; the Furnace Cloak landing on someone in the lava adds combo once. dredge: each wave that hits a hunter adds wave.
